11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.

content.text:
Built a complete playable 3D-style vampire-survival game in `index.html`.

Features include:
- WASD/arrow and mobile touch movement
- Auto-targeting attacks
- Enemy waves and XP gems
- Level-up upgrade choices
- Boss encounter
- Health, kills, timer, and XP HUD
- Restartable game-over flow

Note: The local capture server was not retained by the environment, but the game is ready to serve at the project root.
